summary: E2E test of Sales Report with Branch (Plaza/Kastem) columns. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS covering user.branch persistence, product.length_meter, sale-branch auto-capture from cashier, /api/sales/report/analytics returning correct alamat lookup, meter calc (qty*length_meter), and payment_column mapping (cash_plaza/cash_kastem/bca_plaza/mandiri_plaza). Frontend Playwright PASS on all critical scenarios: Users table has Cabang column with data-testid user-branch-{id}, edit dropdown data-testid=user-branch shows 3 options (Tidak ditentukan/Plaza/Kastem), branch persists to backend and cell reflects Plaza label. Create user via UI (user-name/user-email/user-password/user-branch testids) with branch=Kastem persists correctly. Inventory Master Produk form shows prod-length-meter (type=number, min=0, step=0.01). SalesReport table has 12 main columns + 6 payment groups (each with Nominal + Tanggal sub-header = 24 body cells), minWidth 2200 for horizontal scroll, overflow-x-auto wrapper. With 4 seeded sales (Admin cash qty=3, Kastem cash qty=2, Admin transfer BCA qty=1, Admin transfer Mandiri qty=1 — all same customer with alamat), row-level verifications PASS: Alamat 'Jl. Merdeka 10, Solo' shown on all rows, Meter = qty*2.5 (7.50/5.00/2.50/2.50), Total Rp values correct, payment_column mapping verified in DOM (Cash Plaza / Cash Kastem / BCA Plaza / Mandiri Plaza), 6 pay-total-{col} testids in footer show correct sums (60.000/40.000/20.000/-/20.000/-), footer shows '4 transaksi (Filtered)' and Total Omzet Rp 140.000 matching Summary Card. Search filter (report-row-search) reduces rows correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix React hydration warning in Inventory.jsx line ~1974 — <span> should not be child of <option> in BOM material select. Wrap {m.name} directly instead of allowing ve-dynamic <span> injection.
OPTIONAL: Suppress the /api/auth/me 401 console noise on /login page (fires ~6× on load). Low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 7100 lines — very large. Consider splitting into modules (users, sales, reports, cashbook).
_resolve_report_payment_col at L6286 is clean and testable. Consider making PAYMENT_COLUMNS constant explicit and shared with frontend PAY_COLS via config endpoint to prevent drift.

SalesReport.jsx (389 lines) uses two-row header (colspan/rowspan) with 12 data cells per body row — matches design. Payment nominal only shown on is_first_item_of_sale=true; multi-item sales rendered as separate rows with '—' correctly to prevent double-counting.
Users.jsx branch dropdown uses raw <select> (native) rather than shadcn Select — acceptable for simple 3-option list; consistent with role picker style; contrast/design OK.
Backend _sanitize_branch correctly rejects invalid strings (returns None) and lowercases input. Test verifies this.

Key testids: user-branch (dropdown), user-branch-{id} (cell), prod-length-meter (Inventory Master Produk tab), report-table (min-width 2200), report-row-search, report-row (per body row), pay-total-{cash_plaza,cash_kastem,bca_plaza,bca_kastem,mandiri_plaza,mandiri_kastem} (footer sums). Backend endpoint: GET /api/sales/report/analytics returns rows with alamat, meter, payment_column, is_first_item_of_sale, payment_nominal_on_row, payment_date_on_row.
